benchmark_name: Qwen3-32B four-physical-accelerator independent operator-domain extrapolation confirmation v4

deployment.decode_initial_kv_policy: the measured runtime remains the 8K baseline; Decode validation may use a larger preparation-only scheduler budget so the complete initial-KV prompt cohort enters Decode together

measurement.scheduler_budget_note: Decode uses 16K only to construct the initial KV cohort in one scheduler iteration; Prefill and the target runtime protocol remain at 8K, and the preparation budget is not a calibration input

split_policy.operator_profile_usage: frozen inner-grid profile with batch <= 8 and length <= 1024
split_policy.calibration_usage: offline 15-point Decode communication-aware candidate frozen before v4 ground truth collection
split_policy.prediction_order: write and hash the complete v4 prediction before collecting any v4 ground truth
split_policy.ground_truth_usage: independent confirmation only; forbidden for refitting, selecting, or modifying the frozen candidate
split_policy.overlap_rule: no v4 shape may overlap the 15-point calibration set or the v3 development-validation set; every case must exceed at least one dominant operator-work coordinate

score.per_case: absolute prediction error and later candidate/reference throughput ratio
score.axis_aggregation: arithmetic mean absolute percentage error grouped by extrapolation_axis

scope.coverage: independent confirmation of attention-work and Decode batch-size extrapolation after candidate selection on v3
scope.not_claimed: arbitrary shapes beyond the deployment token and memory limits
